inj.note: Coach Jim Harbaugh said after the latest loss that Herbert "could" have a fracture. The quarterback was pulled from the game with Book P out of hand in the fourth quarter, but Herbert apparently lobbied to stay in the contest. He'll have an extra day to heal up ahead of next Monday night's date with the Ravens. Herbert has been well off the fantasy radar for much of the season in this broken Los Angeles offense. If he can't face Baltimore, DJ Uiagalelei would likely get the nod under center. He completed two of seven passes for 24 yards and a touchdown in relief of Herbert on Sunday.

news.h: Herbert to undergo testing after exiting Chargers' 44-22 loss with finger injury
news.d: Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert, who was sacked eight times and threw his NFL-leading 11th interception, left Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans in the second half with an injury to the middle finger on his left (non-throwing) hand.

news.h: Harbaugh on Rams DB's 'deli meat' comment on Herbert: 'It's not what I see'
news.d: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh, asked about Quentin Lake's comments on Justin Herbert's struggles against the Rams, says, "I don't see that."

news.h: NFL Week 9 latest intel, buzz questions, fantasy tips and trade deadline news

news.h: Jim Harbaugh backs Mike McDaniel, Justin Herbert despite Chargers' post-bye dud
news.d: Jim Harbaugh continued to back both offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel and quarterback Justin Herbert after the Chargers' latest loss Sunday.

news.h: Matthew Stafford and Rams overcome slow start, rally past winless Chargers 24-9
news.d: — Aaron Donald sprinted after Justin Herbert's loose fumble with almost nothing but open turf between him and his first touchdown for the Los Angeles Rams.
